'''Merrk's Weapons Shop''' was a distributor of weapons during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], based on the concourse of [[Pegg]]'s main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. This shop was know to sell weapons to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] without registering the purchases with the local government.
